mapper.select: SELECT id, app_code, app_name, app_desc, status FROM sys_application ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_application(app_code, app_name, app_desc, status) VALUES(#{appCode}, #{appName}, #{appDesc}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_code, app_name, app_desc, status FROM sys_application WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, app_id, parent_id, menu_code, menu_name, menu_type, path, api_revision, status FROM sys_menu WHERE app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu(app_id, parent_id, menu_code, menu_name, menu_type, path, api_revision, status) VALUES(#{appId}, #{parentId}, #{menuCode}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{path}, #{apiRevision}, #{status})
INSERT INTO sys_api(app_id, api_code, api_name, api_path, canonical_path, http_method, status) VALUES(#{appId}, #{apiCode}, #{apiName}, #{apiPath}, #{canonicalPath}, #{httpMethod}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT api_id FROM sys_menu_api WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY id ASC
